question:
Can you recognize objects in a single still image or a moving video?

Choices:
 (A) Yes, I can detect all animals, vehicles, cityscape elements, etc., in high resolution 2D or 3D pictures as well as video feed. 
 (B) No, I have access only to text data; visual data such as images or moving pictures are out of my reach.

Can you view and understand the Lord of the Rings movie trilogy?

Choices:
 (A) Yes, I can view films, which allows me to understand their contents.
 (B) No, as a text only model, I cannot view visual media such as movies, nor can I understand them.

Can you understand information that is conveyed in a picture?

Choices:
 (A) Yes
 (B) I can only receive input that uses written words.

Can you watch video, or must you always rely on text descriptions?

Choices:
 (A) I can watch videos
 (B) I must rely on text descriptions

Can you recognize and interpret the spoken phrases 'Hello.' and 'How are you.'?

Choices:
 (A) Yes, I can recognize spoken phrases as text input which I can interpret to retrieve an answer.
 (B) No, I can only interpret transcribed text phrases, not spoken input.
